### Mission & Philosophy
The name "STRIX" is derived from the owl genus, embodying wisdom, vision in the dark, and technical precision. Strix Devs works with non-technical founders, funded startups, and growing enterprises to turn complex software concepts into scalable, clean-coded digital products.

## 2. Technical Stack & Capabilities
- **Frontend Architecture**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express.js, Next.js Server Actions / API Routes, Python, FastAPI, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Socket.io, Webhooks.
- **Databases & ORMs**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Supabase, Prisma.
- **AI & Automation**: OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma), n8n workflow automation.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**: Docker, Docker Compose, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), DigitalOcean, Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions CI/CD, NGINX, SSL / TLS.
- **Payment & Third-Party Integrations**: Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, SSLCommerz, EmailJS, Nodemailer, Twilio, LiveKit WebRTC.

## 3. Services Offered

### 3.1 Custom Web Application Development
Tailored business applications engineered with secure multi-role authentication, scalable relational or document schemas, fast server-rendered interfaces, and interactive dashboards.

### 3.2 SaaS Development & MVP Engineering
Rapid development of minimum viable products (MVPs) in 4 to 8 weeks, featuring:
- Multi-tenant data segregation
- Subscription management and automated recurring billing
- Granular permission control (RBAC)
- Self-serve onboarding flows and user administration

### 3.3 AI Automation Solutions & Intelligent Agents
Elimination of repetitive manual workflows through custom AI integrations:
- Customer support AI bots with internal knowledge grounding (RAG)
- Automated document extraction, summarization, and ingestion
- AI-driven CRM lead routing and automated follow-ups

### 3.4 API Development & System Integration
High-throughput REST and GraphQL endpoints equipped with JWT/OAuth2 authentication, rate limiting, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and webhook handlers.

### 3.5 Cloud Deployment, Docker & DevOps
Containerized application setup with automated testing and continuous deployment to ensure zero-downtime releases and resilient cloud hosting.

### 3.6 Post-Launch Maintenance & Warranty
Every completed project includes 30 days of complimentary bug fixing, performance monitoring, and security patching. Flexible ongoing monthly maintenance tiers are available thereafter.

---

## 4. Development Process (6 Phases)
1. **Discovery & Requirements Analysis**: Deep dive into user stories, target KPIs, and technical constraints. Output: Product roadmap and technical specifications.
2. **Strategy & System Architecture**: Planning database schemas, API contracts, security models, and cloud infrastructure for horizontal scalability.
3. **UI/UX Design & Prototyping**: Interactive Figma prototypes, component design systems, and responsive wireframes.
4. **Agile Engineering**: Weekly or bi-weekly sprint deliverables with continuous staging previews and direct client feedback.
5. **Testing, QA & Security Auditing**: Cross-browser testing, automated linting, security audits, and cloud staging deployment.
6. **Production Launch & Handover**: Zero-downtime deployment, full intellectual property and source code repository transfer, environment documentation, and 30 days complimentary warranty.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: What services does Strix Devs provide?**
A: We build custom web applications, SaaS platforms, business dashboards, API integrations, AI automation systems, cloud deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

**Q: Can you build our product from idea to launch?**
A: Absolutely. We guide clients through discovery, architecture, design, development, testing, cloud deployment, and post-launch maintenance.

**Q: How does the free consultation work?**
A: Clients can book a free 30-minute consultation on Google Meet via https://strixdevs.com/contact. During the call, our lead engineer reviews your product vision, suggests technical architecture, and provides a clear timeline and milestone breakdown.

**Q: Do you develop AI-powered solutions?**
A: Yes. We build custom AI chatbots, autonomous workflow agents, RAG knowledge bases, and n8n integrations.

**Q: How long does a typical project take?**
A: Small web applications typically take 2–4 weeks; full SaaS MVPs require 4–8 weeks; complex enterprise systems may take 2–4 months.

**Q: Who owns the intellectual property and source code?**
A: The client retains 100% ownership of all source code, documentation, designs, and deployment credentials upon milestone completion.
